ROSAI_DORFMAN.name: Rosai-Dorfman disease (sinus histiocytosis with massive lymphadenopathy)

characteristic_features: extranodal involvement in ~40% (skin, sinonasal, orbit, upper respiratory tract, CNS, bone)

biomarkers.name: Emperipolesis (intact lymphocytes within histiocyte cytoplasm)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Characteristic diagnostic feature when present, but not entirely specific/pathognomonic

biomarkers.name: S100+, CD68+, CD163+, CD1a-
biomarkers.clinical_use: Supports diagnosis and helps distinguish from LCH (CD1a+/langerin+) and ECD (typically S100-negative or only focally positive)

biomarkers.name: SLC29A3 (familial Faisalabad histiocytosis / H syndrome)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Genetic counselling/testing in familial, syndromic, or early-onset cases

biomarkers.name: MAPK pathway mutations (KRAS, NRAS, MAP2K1, ARAF; BRAF less common)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Supports clonality in a subset and may inform use of MEK-pathway-targeted therapy in refractory or aggressive disease

biomarkers.name: Cobimetinib response
biomarkers.clinical_use: MEK inhibitor with activity in histiocytic neoplasms including Rosai-Dorfman disease; may be considered for refractory disease, particularly with MAPK pathway activation

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Large pale S100+/CD68+ histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm containing intact lymphocytes (emperipolesis  characteristic but not pathognomonic)
variants: familial/syndromic Rosai-Dorfman associated with SLC29A3 mutation

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Emperipolesis (intact lymphocytes within histiocyte cytoplasm) is distinctive; MAPK pathway alterations in a subset enable targeted therapy
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Sinus expansion of large pale histiocytes with emperipolesis; polyclonal plasma cell infiltrate

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Histiocytes with distinctive S100+ phenotype; emperipolesis (intact lymphocytes within histiocyte cytoplasm) is a characteristic feature
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Large pale histiocytic differentiation (S100+, CD68+, CD163+) with abundant cytoplasm containing intact lymphocytes (emperipolesis  characteristic feature); CD1a-negative distinguishes from LCH
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: MAPK pathway alterations in a subset enable targeted therapy; familial/syndromic SLC29A3-associated disease has distinct pathogenesis (equilibrative nucleoside transporter defect); IgG4-rich Rosai-Dorfman disease is a recognized clinicopathologic variant
